name: icy-blonde-halloween-party
image_purpose: Halloween event and social party content

prompt.project_info: Create a candid Halloween costume-party portrait with a playful devil costume theme.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman in her early 20s with icy platinum shoulder-length waves, fair skin, natural dewy makeup, bright blue-green eyes and a joyful open smile. She wears a deep red satin devil costume with structured full coverage, decorative metallic red snakeskin-textured ruffle trim, matching opera-length fingerless gloves, red horn headband, white almond-shaped nails and a blue event wristband.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 medium-close framing from hips to above the head, chest-level camera slightly below eye line. The subject faces camera in a slight three-quarter angle, one arm raised near the devil horn and the other near the collarbone. Include a rustic brick column, mustard walls, wooden ceiling beam, hardwood floor and blurred party guests.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden-yellow tungsten party lighting with soft even facial illumination, shallow depth of field, warm skin cast and authentic candid snapshot energy.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical 3:4 smartphone party photography, 35mm-equivalent lens, natural skin texture, realistic satin and glove material, subtle low-light grain, no watermark.
